sloka: सर्वथा सदृशम् सीते मम स्वस्य कुलस्य च ।व्यवसायमनुक्रान्ता कान्ते त्वमतिशोभनम् ॥२-३०-४१॥
transliteration: sarvathā sadṛśam sīte mama svasya kulasya ca ।vyavasāyamanukrāntā kānte tvamatiśobhanam ॥2-30-41॥

translations.english: You, O my lovely beloved Sita, have taken in the right time a highly dignified decision befitting in all ways your family, myself and yourself.
